summary: Shutdown cleanup for a batch of global resources. Cleans pointer arrays in the member structure, releases a sound-manager-style object referenced by dword_8B78A0 via a vtable call, then for each of several global handles/handles performs an optional pre-cleanup handler, a heap free, and zeroing of the global. Returns 0.

operations.description: Array-of-pointers cleanup with a per-element free loop over the `this` structure.
Release the object referenced by global dword_8B78A0 via a vtable call.
If dword_8B8F2C is non-null: invoke the empty-stub hook, free the heap block, then zero the global.
If dword_8B8F04 is non-null: invoke the empty-stub hook, free the heap block, then zero the global.
If dword_8B8F18 is non-null: free the heap block and zero the global.
If dword_8B8F1C is non-null: run the pre-cleanup handler, free the heap block, then zero the global.
If dword_8B8F20 is non-null: free the heap block and zero the global.

unresolved: The exact resource kinds behind the globals (render handles, network config, sound manager) are labelled DERIVED in the existing analysis; the vtable-release path means dword_8B78A0 is read indirectly and only its address is passed to the release call.
